The mRaspberry fluorescent protein is expressed in the cytoplasm, as it lacks any organelle-targeting sequences. TUNEL-FITC staining labels fragmented DNA within the nucleus of apoptotic cells. When observing the injected embryos under a confocal microscope, the most immediate and noticeable observation is the distinct subcellular localization: the red signal (iPSCs) appears cytoplasmic, while any green signal (apoptosis) is nuclear. They do not truly colocalize, and the cytoplasmic localization of the red signal is the first obvious feature.

Answer: A
